data.narrative:
Ouros Energy is a Seed-stage climate and energy company that has raised $3M+ to date. The relevant comp universe spans 9 private peers (including Helion, Redwood Materials, and Electric Hydrogen) alongside one public comparable (Lanza Technologies, ticker LNZA), though direct same-stage and same-valuation-tier peers within Climate & Energy remain sparse.

The valuation analysis relies on a Stage-Progression method, which is applicable given the company's clear developmental stage. Using the $3M total raised as a proxy base value and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied value of $8M. A Peer-Median approach could not be reliably applied, as the filtered Climate & Energy peer set contained fewer than three comparable datapoints at matching stage and valuation tier, making sector-wide medians uninformative without risking overstatement.

The triangulated valuation range is $6M to $9M, with a median point of $8M. This range reflects the inherent uncertainty of single-method triangulation in a stage and sector where tight comparable cohorts are unavailable. Key sensitivities include the magnitude and timing of the next financing round, which will either validate or revise the step-up assumption, and the degree to which public-market Climate & Energy multiples should anchor private valuations given sector volatility.
